artifacts.summary: Decides option (a) relocate-and-trim for the gate 20 ceiling breach on skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md; identifies 3 mechanically-found duplicate-prose relocations (status/persisted_status paragraph, Postflight Boundary section body, Context Flatness Constraint tightening) totaling 1075 B of verified savings against the 930 B needed, with exact before/after text.

memory_candidates.content: verify-deploy.sh gate 20's per-file ceiling sub-check reads only the SOURCE STORE copy of a file via `wc -c` (agent-system/extensions/core/...), never the deployed .claude/ mirror -- so a gate-20 per-file-ceiling fix only needs to land in the source store to go green, even though the normal deploy/sync workflow should still be run afterward to keep the mirror in sync.

lint-postflight-boundary.sh's has_postflight_boundary_section() check only greps for the exact heading text `^## MUST NOT (Postflight Boundary)` in a SKILL.md -- it does not check the body underneath. Any skill carrying that heading can safely shrink the body to a pointer (e.g. into docs/architecture/handoff-schema.md's own fuller 'Postflight Boundary' section) without tripping the lint, as long as the heading text is preserved verbatim.
